name: Koi ni Ochita Kaizokuou
source:
By accident you ended up on a pirate ship, and are given the choice to shack up with the handsome pirate you desire. You join the pirates and travel the high seas, all while discovering love. Each pirate has his own enthralling, unique storyline.
 
Captain Morgan is the charismatic, womanizing leader of the Sirius Pirates.
Chef Nathan is quiet and boorish.
Doctor Christopher is kind, but a little spacey.
Swordsman Russell is hotheaded and passionate.
First mate Eduardo is cold-blooded and twisted.
Apprentice Thomas is determined and friendly.
 
You’ll join the pirates on quests and treasure hunts, and get to join them for parties at night. However, the pirate’s life is still a dangerous one, but you can count on your beloved pirate to rescue you from harm. You and your dream pirate will grow closer through all these heroic acts, but remember, the fun is all in the journey.

[from [url=http://www.capeusa.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=439]Cape USA.org[/url]]
translation:
一场意外让你登上海盗船，并有机会与心仪的英俊海盗相伴。你加入海盗团，扬帆遨游大海，也在旅途中发现爱情。每名海盗都有一条扣人心弦、独具特色的故事线。

船长摩根魅力非凡、风流成性，是天狼星海盗团的领袖。
厨师内森沉默寡言、举止粗鲁。
医生克里斯托弗温柔体贴，却有些天然呆。
剑士罗素脾气火爆、热情奔放。
大副爱德华多冷酷无情、性格扭曲。
见习船员托马斯意志坚定、待人友善。

你会与海盗们一同执行任务、搜寻宝藏，夜晚还能参加他们的宴会。不过，海盗生活终究危机四伏，好在心爱的海盗总会赶来救你脱险。在一次次英勇行动中，你与梦中情人的距离将越来越近——但别忘了，真正的乐趣就在旅途本身。

[译自 [url=http://www.capeusa.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=439]Cape USA.org[/url]]
